title: Spiked Bulb
summary: Throw for 1 Piercing damage and brief Bleeding in an area.

fields.Throw: Action, single use, 60 ft, 13 ft radius. Deals 1 Piercing and inflicts Bleeding for 1 turn.
fields.Bleeding: 2 Slashing at turn start and disadvantage on Constitution saves. Healing removes it.
fields.Acquisition: Nautiloid or Omeluum. No alchemy recipe.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
